about:
LEV Manufacturing operates from Cookeville, Tennessee, with an additional engineering and prototyping hub in Florida. The company serves as the U.S.-based production, engineering, and logistics arm of the Life EV Group of Companies, a structure that emerged from the group's earlier work manufacturing ProdecoTech electric bicycles (2010–2018) and developing the Life EV brand from 2019 onward. After acquiring the Serial 1 e-bike line from Harley-Davidson in 2023, the group formalized LEV Manufacturing in 2024 to handle contract assembly, private-label builds, and FTZ-based production for both its own brands and partner brands.

The company provides end-to-end services for light electric vehicles: design and engineering of platforms, battery packs, and IoT systems; contract assembly and quality control under a Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) for duty-free production; and warehousing with drop-ship fulfillment. Its Florida site handles engineering, prototyping, and logistics, while a 100,000-square-foot Tennessee facility is planned for multi-line assembly and FTZ operations. LEV Manufacturing supports private-label and OEM programs with minimum order quantities of 100–500 units, offering a build-as-you-sell model and $10 million in product liability coverage.

LEV Manufacturing serves the light electric vehicle sector, including e-bike and scooter brands. Its portfolio includes the ProdecoTech line produced under OE manufacturing from 2010 to 2018, the Life EV brand developed since 2019, and the Serial 1 e-bike line acquired from Harley-Davidson in 2023. The company also works with external partner brands seeking contract assembly, private-label production, or FTZ-based import advantages.

LEV Manufacturing emphasizes its FTZ-enabled duty-free assembly, low minimum orders, and domestic component storage as key differentiators. The build-as-you-sell model aims to reduce inventory risk for brands, while U.S.-based warranty support and drop-ship fulfillment shorten delivery times. The planned Tennessee facility is designed to scale multi-line assembly for GEN4 platforms with integrated IoT and battery pack production.
